contexts.text: A state of desolation is called breaking, etc. ().
With Thy right hand, O Jehovah, Thou shalt break in pieces the enemy () = the effect of omnipotence against evils and falsities thence, whose power is annihilated. To break in pieces = to annihilate.
And breaking in pieces thou shalt break in pieces their statues () = that the falsities of worship are to be put away. AC 3727:7.
Whosoever falleth upon that stone shall be broken (). To fall and be broken is to deny and to perish.
No more wasting and destruction () = no evils and falsities; for evils lay waste the natural man, and falsities break it to pieces.
Breaking to pieces () = that there is no longer any truth.
A great breaking () = the dissipation of good and truth.
